description: This file contains Jest test cases for the 'filterCardsAND' function, which filters a list of card objects based on various criteria such as assignee, priority, status, column, due date, and customer request status. It also includes the implementation of the 'filterCardsAND' function copied from 'src/KanbanBoard.js' for testing purposes.
